prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Create a report tree for each accident and assign a doctor.
3. Check all of the information on the claim (if applicable) and copy relevant flight details.
4. Enter all Body Location, Diagnosis, OSHA details.
5. Enter treatment details, accommodation and light duty if applicable.
6. If available enter additional information from the employee.
7. Provide medical follow up for improvement in condition/status.
8. Complete any filings required by jurisdiction and send the relevant medical reports.
9. Validate and sign-off the accident record.
10. Check the accident data for completion and accuracy (must meet the % targets).
11. Validate the report with the respective manager issued.
12. Submit by due date. # Important Considerations

When fulfilling the cost obligations for a workplace injury, it is important to handle the claims as required to ensure that all costs associated with the claim are minimized.
